content.short: Plasma's own stablecoin app and Visa card for spending, saving and sending digital dollars.
content.description: Plasma One is the money app built by the team behind the Plasma chain. Users hold USDT in a self-custody account, spend it with a Visa card at over 130 million merchants with up to 4% cashback, earn yield on their balance and send stablecoins across borders with no fees. Paid tiers add higher cashback on AI and travel spending, including ChatGPT and Claude subscriptions. It is available on iOS and Android and processes tens of millions of dollars in monthly volume on Plasma.
content.meta: Spend USDT with a Visa card, earn yield and send money free with Plasma One, the Plasma chain's own money app.
